label: early copy steps of short (L=3/4) sequences
explanation: Fires almost only in the copy phase (99% of mass) of short sequences (L=3: 48%, L=4: 49% of mass). The main site is the first step after <DEL> (recall_idx=1, input = first original token, which is fed back): 88% of mass. The second copy step (recall_idx=2) accounts for most of the remaining mass, mainly when L=3. In L=3 sequences, recall_idx=1 fires 97% of the time. In L=4 it fires on only about half of sequences, depending on which token is fed back: d, w, k, r, b, p, s, m score high, and many other tokens (e.g. 3, m, y, o, t, x) often stay inactive. Magnitude: largest for L=3 with first token d or w (e.g. d c j <DEL> d), smaller for L=4. Does not fire on the delimiter step, on the original phase (apart from rare weak activations at t=1-2), or on later copy steps or longer sequences (L>=5 together <2% of mass). The simpler rule (recall_idx==1)&(L<=4) gives dev F1 0.62 / mass recall 0.86.
